name: employment_level
notes: Employed persons, Canada 15+, SA monthly. Scaled thousands -> millions. Numerator for per-capita employment growth (Pillar E). Also the headcount comparator in the hours-vs-headcount Labour plate (panel-2c): the Y/Y of employment_level vs Y/Y of aggregate_hours isolates the per-worker-hours channel -- when hours Y/Y slows below employment Y/Y, employers are cutting shifts before they cut bodies (leading-softening signal).
